name: go-interface-lens
description: Fast bidirectional CodeLens navigation between Go interfaces and their implementations

goInterfaceLens.excludedFolders.description: Directory path patterns to exclude before candidate package loading or Tree-sitter parsing. * matches any sequence and ? matches one character. Patterns without a slash match directory names at any depth.

goInterfaceLens.excludedFilePatterns.description: List of file name patterns to exclude when searching for implementations. Use these patterns to filter out generated files, mocks, or test files.

goInterfaceLens.excludedTypePatterns.description: List of type name patterns to exclude from results. Types containing these strings will be filtered out.

goInterfaceLens.excludedPackagePatterns.description: Go package import path patterns to exclude from workspace candidate loading and dependency parsing. * matches any sequence (including /), and ? matches one character.

goInterfaceLens.searchDependencies.description: Search dependency packages for interfaces and concrete implementations during explicit navigation queries. Search is limited to go.mod-locked versions, or to the explicitly configured goModCache root when no lock is available, and results are verified with complete AST method sets.

goInterfaceLens.goModCache.description: Optional absolute path to the Go module cache. Leave empty to auto-detect via $GOMODCACHE, $GOPATH/pkg/mod, then ~/go/pkg/mod.

goInterfaceLens.astConcurrency.description: Maximum worker threads used to parse candidate Go packages. Actual concurrency adapts to the CPU and memory available to the extension host.
